definitions.units: voltage V; current A; resistance ohm; alpha natural-log ratio (base independent)
definitions.branch_rule: First maximum|V| index belongs to outward; all subsequent indices belong to return, including repeated apex.
definitions.current_rule: Use stored magnitude; negative RESET voltage does not imply stored current has physical sign.
definitions.interpolation: None: all readpoints are exact native samples within3e-7V float storage tolerance.
definitions.feature_bands: Uniform empirical Q10-Q90 across eligible training records, chosen before the next fit; not confidence intervals.
definitions.flatness_exception: Within-window log-current span is bounded above by its empiricalQ90 only; a smooth model is allowed to be flatter than individual noisy/fluctuating records and is not forced to reproduce their minimum variation.
definitions.censoring: Below-floor endpoint features retain raw values but do not define primary log-feature distributions; counts explicit.
definitions.first25mV: Preserved everywhere, included in full-curve score; low-resistance fit with/without it reported separately.
definitions.bare_transition: Interval midpoint is descriptive; original last-below/first-crossing bracket retained.
definitions.plateau: Window flatness is evaluated; constant current and state freezing are not assumed.

structural_gates: One common material current law and state evolution for both topologies; no topology-conditioned intrinsic equation.
Measured transistor and instrument compliance enter only external circuit closure; use solved material voltage/current.
Continuous1T state propagation including SET return, RESET and cycle boundaries; no per-cycle fitted resets.
If using a common initial bare state per conditional record, declare it; do not invent bare inter-record chronology.
KCL/KVL, passivity and numerical refinement checks must pass before comparing accuracy.
proposed_success_criteria_before_next_fi.primary_feature_gate: For every listed primary feature, the median of model-generated training-record features must lie inside its fixed acceptance interval. These are empiricalQ10-Q90 bands, except plateau fluctuation span uses only the empiricalQ90 upper bound (zero model fluctuation is allowed). Report every failure individually; global RMSE cannot compensate. Also report full observed range and model median, not only pass/fail.
proposed_success_criteria_before_next_fi.joint_shape_gate: Simultaneously satisfy1T SET returnI(0.2V),I(2V),I(4V), the1-2/2-4V slope change, RESET peak current and1.0-1.4V plateau level/flatness. These must arise in one continuously propagated trajectory with one material parameter set.
proposed_success_criteria_before_next_fi.score_reporting: Report true ordered record-level log RMSE for training1T4-35, all bare records, each phase/branch; separate bare SET limited/nonlimited. Keep raw scatter in totals. Do not substitute a two-cycle surrogate or median curve for these scores.
proposed_success_criteria_before_next_fi.secondary_data_scaled_curve_target: Proposed smooth-curve accuracy target: systematic deviation of predicted mean log curve from observed mean log curve no larger than the corresponding empirical within-index RMS spread. This is a training reference, not a guaranteed noise floor. For a fixed common curve the equivalent total-RMSE reference is sqrt(2) times spread; cycle-dependent predictions require exact bias/variance/covariance decomposition.
proposed_success_criteria_before_next_fi.noncompensation: A failed low-read/plateau/transition feature remains failed even if other voltage regions improve. Quantization-level compliance-platform variance is not a stand-alone intrinsic-material acceptance target.
proposed_success_criteria_before_next_fi.model_discovery_limit: Passing these curve gates supports mathematical consistency and descriptive adequacy, not unique microscopic mechanism identification.
proposed_success_criteria_before_next_fi.transistor_mapping_condition: All numerical feature gates here concern measured terminal curves and do not require any particular deembeddedRh trend. Treat positive-SET internalRh increase/decrease as conditional on forward gate interpolation/current-scale assumptions; the reverse table has a1.1V node. No±20% calibration confidence is claimed. A legitimate external mapping profile precedes rejection of the shared material law on that internal trend.

assumption_registry.statement: Use recovered Git workbooks as current experimental records; native cache values are unchanged.
assumption_registry.source: Recovered workbook/native-cache equality audit; current training-array digest
assumption_registry.evidence: No interpolation, clipping or resampling in this script
assumption_registry.if_violated: Rebuild constraints from corrected original source.

assumption_registry.statement: Treat the regular voltage column as nominal terminal command for circuit modeling; separately expose actual hBN voltage under compliance.
assumption_registry.source: Native regular ramps and1mA plateau; voltage header AV
assumption_registry.need: Avoid driving material with5V while reporting1mA through~100ohm
assumption_registry.evidence: Strong circuit consistency, not independent instrument readback documentation
assumption_registry.if_violated: Use verified readback voltage and measurement model; preserve both columns.

assumption_registry.statement: Bare SET has1mA compliance; bare RESET is not clipped at1mA.
assumption_registry.source: Prior confirmed protocol and raw RESET peaks above1mA
assumption_registry.evidence: Raw peak/current distributions in this report
assumption_registry.if_violated: Replace with documented instrument settings; do not change intrinsic law by topology.

assumption_registry.statement: Measured branch slopes are trajectory features; they do not establish a frozen hidden state or a constitutive derivative.
assumption_registry.source: No state-resolved measurements accompany these sweeps
assumption_registry.if_violated: Use independent retention/pulse constraints before asserting frozen-state laws.

assumption_registry.statement: 1T1R numbered SET/RESET pairs4-35 are treated as an ordered sequence; first3 remain outside primary normal-operation targets.
assumption_registry.source: Existing confirmed S/R pairing and advisor exclusion
assumption_registry.need: State continuity and fixed training scope
assumption_registry.if_violated: Revise sequence metadata; never infer missing elapsed time.

assumption_registry.statement: Bare same-label SET-to-RESET pairing is conditional; chronology between bare sheets and physical cell identity are not asserted.
assumption_registry.source: Workbook labels; absent independent chronology/cell map
assumption_registry.evidence: Low read consistency is evidence of compatibility only
assumption_registry.if_violated: Use verified cell/sequence metadata, retaining raw labels.

assumption_registry.statement: Same nominal stack/geometry motivates a shared material equation; individual microscopic states need not be identical.
assumption_registry.source: Zhu Nature Methods and SI chip layout, previously verified
assumption_registry.evidence: Common nominal Au-Ti/hBN/W geometry, distinct physical cells
assumption_registry.if_violated: Document measured structural differences before allowing corresponding parameters.

assumption_registry.statement: No physical dwell time, sweep speed, thermal transient or cell identity is inferred from voltage-point spacing.
assumption_registry.if_violated: Add measured time/protocol data before calibrating rates in seconds.

assumption_registry.statement: Historical phase current floors are reporting/censor thresholds, not certified instrument detection limits.
assumption_registry.evidence: Censored raw values remain present and counts are reported
assumption_registry.if_violated: Repeat with documented noise/offset model and preserve threshold sensitivity.

assumption_registry.statement: Empirical Q10-Q90 feature bands and within-index scatter are descriptive training variability, not confidence intervals or irreducible noise.
assumption_registry.source: Fixed repeated-record feature definitions before next fit
assumption_registry.evidence: No iid/population or new-device coverage claim
assumption_registry.if_violated: Use validated stochastic/state model and independent experiments for population claims.

assumption_registry.statement: The positive SET transistor mapping at nominalVG=1.1V is interpolated between1.0V/1.5V gate curves. The reverse lookup contains a1.1V node; this does not independently establish same-transistor identity. Internal hBN resistance trends are conditional on the appropriate mapping.
assumption_registry.source: Independent direct lookup inventory: SET gates0.5,1.0,1.5,...; reverse table0.1V gate spacing includes1.1V
assumption_registry.need: Separate raw terminal-shape evidence from deembedded-material inference
assumption_registry.evidence: Reviewer reports SET mapping scale~0.8 or effectivegate~1.03V can change the inferred internal resistance trend; these are assumption tests, not established calibration uncertainty bounds
assumption_registry.if_violated: Keep raw terminal feature gates; report polarity-specific mapping-conditioned inference and profile justified gate interpolation before introducing new material physics.
